reasons: Semester 5 is an exchange semester (0 MC), so the required courses cannot be taken then. The student must take CS2102, CS2105, CS3247, CS4211, CS4261, and CS4220 in semesters 6, 7, and 8. CS4261 requires MA1100/MA1100T/CS1231S/CS1231, which the student has not completed (only CS1231S is completed, which satisfies the prerequisite, but CS4261 also requires EE2012A/EE2012/ST2131/MA2216/ST2334/MA2116/MA2116T, none of which are completed. Thus, CS4261 cannot be taken until a math prerequisite is completed. The student has not listed any math prerequisites as completed or required, making CS4261 impossible to schedule without adding unplanned courses, which is not allowed unless they are prerequisites for planned courses. Even if we assume the student has the math prereqs implicitly, CS4261 requires CS2040/CS2040S etc (satisfied) and MA1100/MA1100T/CS1231S/CS1231 (CS1231S is completed, so satisfied). However, the other math prereq (EE2012A/EE2012/ST2131/MA2216/ST2334/MA2116/MA2116T) is NOT satisfied by any completed course. Therefore, CS4261 is not eligible. Since CS4261 is a 'must' course, no plan exists.
